description: Negative control: blocked cases that do not depend on an open question about what they verify - one verifies no AC, one repeats another's open question for the same AC.

append_test_cases.title: Re-adding a carted product merges into the existing line
append_test_cases.objective: Clarify F-1. Assumption: one line per product.

steps.action: Click "Add to cart" on Demo Mug twice.
steps.expected_result: The cart has one Demo Mug line with quantity 2 (assumed answer to F-1).

append_test_cases.title: Rapid double-click on Add to cart adds two units to one line
append_test_cases.objective: Clarify F-1 again under double-click. Assumption: one line per product.

steps.action: Double-click "Add to cart" on Demo Mug.
steps.expected_result: The cart has one Demo Mug line with quantity 2 (assumed answer to F-1).

append_test_cases.title: Out-of-stock product shows a sold-out message
append_test_cases.objective: Clarify F-2. Assumption: a 'Sold out' message is shown.

steps.action: Click "Add to cart" on an out-of-stock Demo Lamp.
steps.expected_result: The message 'Sold out' is shown and the cart stays empty (assumed answer to F-2).
